cameraObscuraCreature.description:
{green|Camera Obscura}

This mysterious war machine shares five casts per battle between Age (reduces maximum health by 33% for three rounds) and Summon Apparition (raises temporary Apparitions from fallen friendly living stacks, consuming their corpses). Migdigravia grants three additional casts, +10 summoning power per five hero levels and one extra round of Apparition lifetime.

The Camera costs 3000 gold at an adventure-map War Machine Factory and can also be found as an artifact. Migdigravia starts with one Camera.

Both spells are available to any owner. Summon Apparition requires an eligible fallen friendly living stack; undead, non-living, Gargoyles, mechanical creatures and war machines cannot be used. The Camera has 125 HP and cannot retaliate.

potionCartCreature.description:
{green|Potion Cart}

The Potion Cart supplies the hero's spellbook with potions for the battle. Cost: 1500 gold; 125 HP. Potions cost no mana and require a living allied Potion Cart. Existing potion effects keep their normal duration after the Cart is destroyed.

{gold|Potions and First Aid:}
{silver|Regeneration Potion:} Restores 5/15/30 HP of the wounded creature per turn, or full regeneration at Expert First Aid. Does not resurrect fallen creatures.
{silver|Vial of Poison:} 10/15/20/30% chance to poison the attacked enemy (no skill/Basic/Advanced/Expert First Aid).
{silver|Dragon Drought:} Unlocked at Basic First Aid. Grants dragon nature and breath attack with a 15/20/25% chance of Immolation at Basic/Advanced/Expert First Aid.
{silver|Toughness Tonic:} Unlocked at Advanced First Aid: +25% HP and +15% damage; at Expert, +40% HP and +20% damage.
{silver|Etheral Extract:} Unlocked at Expert First Aid. Grants teleportation and 20% physical and magical damage reduction.

Caballe grants +1 Morale to good and +1 Luck to neutral creatures affected by a potion.

cameraObscuraCreature.description:
{green|Camera Obscura}

This camera was planed as second war machine available in Courtyard. This mysterious machine can cast spells 5 times per battle. Camera can cast Age spell on enemy units (duration - 3 turns) or can revive friedly dead stacks as Apparitions (mechanism similar to Pit Lord's deamon summoning). Now you have two options to have this machine in your army.
- sometimes it can be found in random generated maps as 'artifact'.
- Heroine Migdigravia starts with one Camera that can be transferred to other hero.

potionCartCreature.description:
{green|Potion Cart}

Potion Cart adds potions to hero's spellbook. Cost: 1500 gold. Using potions - 0 mana points. After destroying the cart, potions vanish.

Potions:
{silver|Regeneration Potion:} Grants unit regeneration ability (5 points/turn).
{silver|Vial of Poison:} Grants unit a chance to poison the attacked enemy (10%).

Heroes with basic First Aid have additional potion:
{silver|Dragon Drought:} Grants unit dragon nature and dragon breath attack, which has a chance of setting enemy unit aflame.

Heroes with advanced First Aid have additional potion:
{silver|Toughness Tonic}: Increases unit's hit points by 25% and damage dealt by unit by 15%.

Heroes with expert First Aid have additional potion:
{silver|Etheral Extract:} Grants unit ability to fly and 20% damage reduction from spells and attacks.
